content: GitHub changelog 2025-06-03: releases automatically compute SHA256 digests for all uploaded release assets, generated at upload time, immutable, exposed via Releases REST API asset.digest, GraphQL, gh CLI, and the UI. Empirically verified 2026-08-22: local sha256 of downloaded scip-swift v0.3.0 tarball equals the API digest field exactly; digests are backfilled on older releases (v0.1.2 has one). Anonymous unauthenticated GET works; 60 req/hr/IP core rate limit; /releases/latest excludes prereleases+drafts and matches the Latest badge.
